name: Warm humanist
idea: Soft serifs, warm surfaces and friendly illustration: approachable and human.
brief: Warm and human. Content sits on soft --c-surface panels with var(--radius) corners; the ground is light and warm. The display face is a soft serif or a friendly slab, at a friendly (not shouting) scale; text is generous and readable. Illustrations sit inside or beside panels. Lists may use soft numbered markers. Spacing is generous and even.

styles: warm flat illustration, soft shapes, no outlines
